name: Reindeer Herder
body:
You domesticate and train reindeer.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 3 ranks, Ride 3 ranks, either the animal companion, divine bond (mount), or mount class feature.

Benefit(s): This feat affects only reindeer. In temperatures of 40° Fahrenheit (4° Celsius) or less, you and your reindeer animal companion or mount gain the benefits of endure elements whenever you are adjacent to each other. In addition, when you ride your reindeer animal companion or mount, the reindeer can move across snow and icy surfaces without penalty.
